_comment: Camera.Source: USB index ("0"), an rtsp:// URL, or a path to a video file.
The viewer also lets you type a source into the window and press Start,
so this is only the value the field is prefilled with.
Override without editing this file:
EDGEFORGE_Camera__Source=rtsp://user:pass@192.168.1.50:554/h264Preview_01_sub
Detector.ModelPath: an exported YOLOv8 .onnx (imgsz=640, opset=12).
Leave it empty for the deterministic SampleDetector, which draws nothing
useful but proves the pipeline and the window are alive.
Detector.ClassId is a COCO index: 15 = cat (development), 14 = bird (coop).
Detector.ExecutionProvider: "directml" runs inference on the GPU, "cpu"
forces the CPU. DirectML falls back to the CPU on its own if no DX12 GPU
is present; the status bar names whichever one actually opened.
Detector.GpuDeviceId picks the GPU by adapter index. On a laptop with
switchable graphics index 0 is often the integrated chip - here that was
193 ms per frame against 28 ms on the discrete card. The banner lists the
GPUs it can see; if inference is slow, try the other index.
Capture.AutoSaveDetections writes frames containing detections to disk,
throttled by MinIntervalSeconds and MinConfidence and capped by MaxFiles.
This is how the training set for telling individual animals apart gets built,
so leaving it on during a normal day is the point.
